text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heya-hey, Trainer! So, how was your<n>break?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Mine was a blast! I had a super-long<n>video call with
my family for the first<n>time in ages.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My sisters told me what they thought<n>of my races,
and they had a ton of<n>footage to illustrate their
points!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
They were telling me how cool my<n>stride looked
and how impressive it<n>was that I didn't look back...
Hehe. I<n>was blushing like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But it made me want to show themwayyy more cool stuff out on thetrack! All right, time to do this thing!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Ines Fujin made the<n>most of her time
off!
